name: Grafted Twin Shields
description: The Grafted Twin Shields were the primary weapon used by the KX-series droid Hunter K-A0S during the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition. Serving both defensive and offensive tools, these shields could be linked together to form a greater area of protection, or separated to be used as individual melee weapons, and were highly customizable. These shields replaced K-A0S' previous limbs after they were torn off and stolen by fellow Wookiee Hunter Grozz, resulting in a fierce rivalry between the two.
